text:
rachel: deploy-bot just labeled PR#4999 as a minor and created tag v6.2.0 — it changes the CLI flag from `--enable-legacy` to `--legacy-mode`. It's a rename with a compatibility shim. I think patch is better. Thoughts?

deploy-bot: heuristic summary: files touched: cli/, docs/flags.md -> default: minor (source + docs). Rule: flag/CLI option changes default to minor unless PR contains [PATCH] token or an author override.

tony: A rename with a backward-compatible shim shouldn't be a minor. It preserves behavior for existing users. Patch + changelog note explaining deprecation timeline.

release-bot: quick note: the tag is created automatically when the CI job passes. Manual overrides: `./tools/releasebot release --force-patch` or include `[PATCH]` in PR title. You can also add frontmatter `semver: patch` in the PR body.

sylvie: Two policy asks: 1) when deploy-bot tags minor for docs+flag changes, include a rationale blob in the PR so reviewers can act quickly; 2) add a stable-window bias that prefers patch unless the flag adds net new capability.

rachel: Agree. For this change I'm going to annotate the PR with `semver: patch` and run the force-patch job. Also adding a short changelog note: "rename CLI flag; shim added for compatibility; plan to deprecate in 2 releases".

tony: Also: can we add a lint that detects presence of a compatibility shim (e.g., old flag parsed and forwarded) and treat that as 'non-breaking' for heuristics? Might reduce false minors.

sylvie: Filing RFC: rfc/semver-cli-heuristics #34 — proposal: exported CLI surface + presence of compatibility shim => prefer patch. Also: when deploy-bot makes a minor recommendation, it will add a checklist: "affects public API? exports changed? compatibility shim present?"

deploy-bot: enhancement logged. Will add one-line rationale to tagging comment: "reason: docs+cli changes -> default minor" and a checklist annotation link to RFC.

rachel: Forced patch applied: tag v6.1.9 (patch). Posting to #release-notes: "v6.1.9 (patch) - CLI flag rename with compatibility shim; deprecation scheduled" :white_check_mark:

tony: tiny bookkeeping: ensure the release-notes generator maps `semver: patch` frontmatter to Bugfixes and doesn't promote this to Features. We've had that happen before.

sylvie: Will update the generator mapping in releng. Also adding examples in the playbook for CLI-only changes vs API changes.

release-bot: noted: plan to include tagging rationale in PR bodies + change the default for docs+flag-only edits during stable windows to patch.

rachel: closing thread. Thanks all!
